preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= n0 <= 100 and 0 <= n1 <= 100 and 0 <= n2 <= 100 for n0, n1, n2 in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, n0, n1, and n2 are between 0 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(n0 + n1 + n2 > 0 for n0, n1, n2 in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the sum of n0, n1, and n2 is greater than 0.

postconditions.description: The number of output strings matches the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(output_strings[i] in {'0', '1'} for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: Each output string consists only of the characters '0' and '1'.

postconditions.expression: all(count_pairs(output_strings[i], '00') == test_cases[i][0] for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: The number of '00' pairs in each output string matches the corresponding n0.

postconditions.expression: all(count_pairs(output_strings[i], '01') + count_pairs(output_strings[i], '10') == test_cases[i][1] for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: The number of '01' and '10' pairs in each output string matches the corresponding n1.

postconditions.expression: all(count_pairs(output_strings[i], '11') == test_cases[i][2] for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: The number of '11' pairs in each output string matches the corresponding n2.
